what: SailPoint sells identity security software: it decides who in a company may access which systems, removes access when someone changes role, and proves to auditors that the rules were followed.
customers: Large enterprises and regulated industries, on subscriptions priced by identity managed.
money: software run on customers' own infrastructure
moat: Identity governance is wired into every application a company runs and into its audit evidence, so replacing it means re-proving compliance from scratch.
risks: Still loses money: $197M of net loss on $1.2B of revenue
